title: Install least-privilege CardDemo identities and resource profiles
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of security_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: Two transport identities are installed in separate regular and administrator groups. The ten corpus application sign-on records remain application data, and APPUSER cannot authenticate as a transport identity.
Sixty-four exact default-deny profiles cover all 25 transactions, 26 programs, eight CICS datasets, the JOBS transient-data queue, and scoped Db2, IMS, JES, and operator resources.

A regular identity can execute ordinary transactions and programs, read application data, and write the application queue, but cannot administer users, update datasets, or access Db2, IMS, JES, operator, or unrelated resources.
An administrator receives only the enumerated application permissions; manifest installation is atomic, capacity-bounded, restart-durable, and exactly replayable.
RACF audits persist across restart and replace password, card-number, queue-payload, and protected-field values with a redaction marker before durable storage.
